answer: The strongest sybil defense is on-ledger slashing: each verifier stakes a bond at dawn, and the kernel burns that stake whenever it countersigns an invalid transaction, with the burn set above the total reward earnable in a full zenith epoch. Identity becomes costly because faking verifier nodes means posting many bonds, and every bad signature converts real capital into public ash. An attacker must risk more than it can gain per epoch, so fake-identity farming is unprofitable by construction.
